utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive list or drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you help with the repair drive list? I’ll handle the drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — send me the list and I’ll tidy it up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how much can you quietly take on, and when should I check back?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take on a small part this week, nothing too noticeable. Check back with me in a few days, please.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll confirm the timing and the drop-off spot, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — once you’ve got those details, I can see if I can fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I might’ve missed the latest details. What did I need to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just bring any broken small appliance or tool you want fixed, and drop it off at the community center by 3 PM. If you can’t make it, I can hold it for you until then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll bring a broken tool by 3. If I get held up, I’ll let you know so you can hold it for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just remind me what needs doing and when.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren—mostly I need help sorting the donated parts and keeping track of who’s bringing what. If you can come by Saturday morning, that would make things much easier.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning works for me—I’ll come by and help sort the parts and keep track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and spread the word to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I can help pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll let a few more folks know and circle back later so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout so far. I’ll swing by later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great, Ira — they could probably use an extra hand later. I’ll let you know if anything comes up before then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just give me a shout if you need me before I come by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. It’s going fine so far—let’s keep to the plan and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—what’s still on the list, and where do you want me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus—before we start, can you tell me what tools you’ve got and what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, hammer, screwdrivers, a wrench set, and a tape measure. First I’d check for loose screws, leaks, and anything unsafe so we can tackle the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple: tell me the time, the place, and what I should bring. Then I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — it’s at the school parking lot on Saturday at 10 a.m., and please bring a screwdriver and work gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 with a screwdriver and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down for a shift or a donation?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with a shift—just let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—what time works best for you, and I’ll put you on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what time is the repair drive starting, and do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m sorry, I don’t have the start time on me yet. If you’ve got a toolbox, that’d be really helpful, and I’ll double-check the time for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring my toolbox. Please let me know the start time as soon as you check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam! Could you help sort donations and keep an eye out for any tools we still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and watch for any missing tools. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help pull folks together for the repair drive—want me to check who’s available and see what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please check who’s actually available and what still needs doing before we count on anyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and make a quick list of who’s available and what tasks are still open.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive stops if you want—just tell me the locations and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Opal—thank you! I’ll send you the stops as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—send them over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Noah, I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you want me to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — could you start by sorting the donated tools into one box and the spare parts into another?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools into one box and the spare parts into another now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting together the repair drive list now, and I’ll keep everything organized so we can get people the help they need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — that sounds great. Let me know where you need me to help, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you help me by checking which neighbors still need repairs and noting any urgent issues? That’ll help me keep the list tidy and get people helped faster.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s already been gathered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo—I’m a little late, but I can help. I don’t have the list yet, so tell me what’s been gathered and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, let’s start with what we have so far, and I’ll mark the gaps as we go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’m in. Just point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Bo — I’ve got a short list: a few loose screws, some tape, and one busted lamp. I’ll point you to the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, let’s start with the loose screws and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still gathering supplies and volunteers, so it should be a good turnout if the weather holds.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I hope so. I’m glad folks are still showing up for it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Me too—people around here always surprise me when something important comes up. I’ll probably swing by and see if they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What part of the repair drive do you want to talk about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’d love your help with the supply list and making sure everyone knows where to drop off donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the supply list and put up a simple drop-off note. If you want, I can also ask around one by one so people don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly small stuff, from what I heard—leaky faucets, loose door hinges, and a few broken outlets. I can check the list again and tell you if there’s anything more specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please check the list again so we don’t miss any details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools and I’m free after 4, so maybe we could start then?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After 4 works for me—I’ll make sure it doesn’t clash with pickup time. Want me to confirm the exact spot and let the neighbors know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just a quick hand moving stuff around and maybe a ride if you’re free. I’ll keep it simple when I know the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, just let me know when you’ve got the time nailed down and I’ll see what I can do.
